x: The ever reliable Will Cockerell produced one point more than anticipated in the steeplechase and then came our only maximum point event of the day as William Sharman won the A 110H in deteriorating conditions and Dom Girdler did likewise in the B race.

A tired Dom Girdler dragged himself over the barriers to win the B and complete yet another max points performance for our sprint hurdlers. The 400m saw a welcome introduction to the team for junior Ryan Thomas who ran well for third in the B.
With William Sharman in Gothenberg, Dom Girdler seamlessly stepped into the A 110 hurdles and despite lack of training due to heavy work commitments finished a good second in the A race.
